thread:
maria: Heads-up—running into duplicates on the new lazy-retry sample app when auth refresh happens mid-stream. Repro steps below.

maria: Steps: 1) start streaming request -> 2) short-lived token expires -> 3) SDK refreshes and retries -> 4) upstream got same request twice, server responded 200 then 409 then we saw 429 flood downstream.

maria: Logs:
```json
{"req_id":"r-abc123","phase":"initial","status":200}
{"req_id":"r-abc123","phase":"retry","status":200}
{"req_id":"r-abc123","phase":"server","status":429}
```

dan: Oof. Is this the Node sample app or the Python one? Which SDK version?

maria: Node sample app, using @redwood/sdk-js 0.6.2. We added the 'lazyRefresh' flag in onboarding sample to reduce noise.

lee: My guess: refresh triggered while streaming + retry semantics re-sent same payload with no idempotency key + server treats it as new request -> duplicate work. We should add idempotency header for streaming chunked requests.

sasha: Also we saw that current jitter/backoff math clamps jitter to 0.0 for streaming paths to avoid latency, which removes spread and causes thundering retries after 401s. Consider tunable jitter for auth-refresh path.

maria: Proposed quick mitigations:
- sample app: set `authorization.refresh_mode = "eager"` for streaming onboarding
- SDK: attach `Idempotency-Key` (uuid) for all non-idempotent endpoints when streaming is enabled
- Server: treat requests with same Idempotency-Key as deduped within 60s

sam: Small counter: attaching idempotency to every streaming chunk will add memory on server. Maybe only attach to request start tokens (start_of_stream) and have server dedupe by stream_id + seq.

dan: Agree with sam. Another option: SDK should not retry after a 401 for streaming by default; instead surface a 'refresh_needed' event to the app so app can decide.

ci-bot: deploy-report: sampleapp-ci failed on streaming-integration (flaky) — https://ci/redwood/987

lee: Can we add a unit/integration test that simulates token expiry mid-stream and asserts single effective request? That should catch regressions.

maria: I've opened a tiny PR to the sample app that flips refresh_mode to eager and adds a note in onboarding: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/412

sasha: For SDK changes I propose:
```js
retryConfig: { maxRetries: 3, baseMs: 100, maxMs: 2000, jitter: 0.4 },
streaming: { doNotRetryOn401: true, idempotencyMode: "start-only" }
```
Let's add a feature flag so we can toggle in prod.

sam: Also log correlation: include `client_stream_id` and `attempt` in logs so we can tie duplicates together.

maria: Owners: maria (sample app PR), lee + sasha (SDK design), dan (server dedupe feasibility). Can we ship quick patch for onboarding before next release? @here

dan: I'll look at server dedupe tonight. If not viable, we'll opt for SDK "doNotRetryOn401" default for streaming and document tradeoffs.

sasha: I'll draft SDK proposal and include benchmarks for memory impact.

maria: Thanks — let's land sampleapp PR first so new users don't hit this during onboarding. Followups: add integration test, SDK PR, server ticket.

maria: Action items in thread:
- PR #412: sampleapp eager refresh (maria)
- SDK RFC: streaming-retry-idempotency (sasha + lee)
- Server ticket: dedupe-by-idempotency (dan)
- Test: streaming-token-expiry-integration (sam)

lee: Sounds good. If anyone wants to pair on the SDK test harness ping me.

maria: Leaving notes in onboarding doc and demo script. :white_check_mark:
